async def nudge_confidence(self, scope: str, item_id: str, delta: float) -> MemoryItem | None:
        """Adjust confidence by delta (clamped to [0.0, 1.0]); return updated item or None if missing."""
        async with self._lock:
            path = self._item_path(scope, item_id)
            if not path.exists():
                return None
            item = self._load_item(path)
            new_confidence = max(0.0, min(1.0, item.confidence + delta))
            updated = item.model_copy(update={"confidence": new_confidence})
            self._atomic_write(path, self._dump_item(updated))
            self.rebuild_index(scope, self._list_scope_locked(scope))
            return updated
